title: Total power loss at 100 kt and autorotation
flown: trimmed 100 kt at 4000 ft (the 40 s of autorotation need the height; from 1000 ft the ground comes first); both engines fail at t = 0; controls fixed 1.0 s; collective full down over 1.0 s; from t = 2 s the autopilot in its autorotation mode flies 65 kt with the cyclic and the ball with the pedals, and moves the collective only to keep NR near 100 % (it stays near the bottom stop)
